summary: Samos Energy Acquisition Corp, a Cayman Islands blank-check company listed on the NYSE, filed an 8-K announcing that holders of its IPO units may elect to separately trade the Class A ordinary shares and warrants beginning August 31, 2026. Each unit comprises one Class A share (SAMO) and one-half of one warrant (SAMO.WS), each whole warrant exercisable at $11.50. Unseparated units continue trading as SAMO.U; no fractional warrants will trade. No board recommendation, advisor, price, stake or premium is stated. Risk-arb focus: separation is routine SPAC mechanics, with attention on the pending de-SPAC timeline and trust redemption dynamics.
